feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: D.C. airspace is complicated. Experts say Trump's arch would add one more risk
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to build its 250-foot arch near one of the country's busiest runways. The FAA will determine whether that poses a hazard. But independent experts already have concerns.

entry.title: Pediatricians raise the alarm on the effect of Trump's immigration crackdown on kids
entry.summary: The Trump administration has been pursuing a quiet immigration crackdown strategy: limiting access to health care and public services. The American Academy of Pediatrics is sounding the alarm about the impact on children.

entry.title: A Sikh truck driver is stabbed amid a rise in anti-South Asian rhetoric
entry.summary: The driver said he was shaken by a violent encounter at a rest stop, which he described as unprovoked.

entry.title: People's houses are collapsing into the ocean. FEMA gives them no other option
entry.summary: Waterfront homes are collapsing along the coast. Homeowners generally have plenty of warning before their house buckles. So why aren't most houses removed, or at least emptied, before they fall?

entry.title: 4 measles-associated deaths reported in Pennsylvania amid outbreak
entry.summary: There have been four measles-associated deaths in Pennsylvania this summer amid a growing outbreak in the state.

entry.title: A law requiring U.S.-made materials is slowing the construction of affordable homes
entry.summary: A law requires builders to use American-made construction materials if they want to get certain federal funds. It's slowing affordable housing construction.

entry.title: Why people are leaving entire houses to fall into the ocean
entry.summary: NPR dug into the upside-down world of FEMA flood insurance in coastal areas, and found many homeowners have no financial choice but to let their homes collapse.

entry.title: Committee investigating Epstein holds billionaire Leon Black in contempt of Congress
entry.summary: Billionaire investor Leon Black refused to appear before the committee investigating convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein for a deposition. Now it's up to the Department of Justice whether to pursue criminal charges.

entry.title: The 'burnerverse' exploiting young women in college
entry.summary: Wired reporter EJ Dickson speaks with NPR's Juana Summers about an online community that targets and harasses young women with their own nonconsensual, sexually explicit images.

entry.title: DOJ charges Russian agents with plotting attacks, including in the U.S.
entry.summary: The indictment says the defendants belong to a network that "is one arm of the Russian Federation's apparatus used to carry out external attacks" worldwide.
